question: What changes when existing dated programs are combined under one resource and market account?
inputs: Exact context21 programs from93fa; preserved source_profile/source_network sales, flights and capacity; C demand recipe only
baseline: Each singleton must reproduce its source result; portfolio additive totals are diagnostic comparators, not automatically admitted joint results
resource: Namespace every component's flights AND working tails as distinct additional supply; one shared reserve scenario. Required working tails are summed, never merged by same aircraft label. Current ceiling4working+1reserve; larger portfolios CONDITIONAL_RESOURCE_ENVELOPE_ONLY, required future increment explicit, not claimed available today or in2027.
physical_limits: Existing calendar and turnaround retained per component. No inferred slots, handling capacity, crew/maintenance feasibility or actual new fleet availability. Simultaneous modeled departures may require additional airport capacity.
market: One directed final OD pool per portfolio. Shared scalar D/fare/old cap must agree across components or reject; local/transfer product status must agree for this experiment. No duplicated old-RW seat budget.
capture_laws: COUNT_ALL_OFFERS: same author response at total offered itineraries, then equal requested allocation across offers
COUNT_DISTINCT_DEPARTURE_TIMES: same response at distinct first-leg departure dates/times for that OD, then equal requested allocation across offers
capture_status: Two explicit scenarios, neither uniquely mandated by the hard entire-D bound. Coincident departures can add seats without proving more temporal convenience.
allocation: Source local-first and net marginal order; individual itinerary through fare once; capacity shared; no new cross-component transfers introduced
financial_scope: Variable incremental contribution only. Full budget subtracts additional working/reserve tail burden, one UFA base if used, distinct launch/support/donor effects once. Existing sunk allocations not charged as incremental by default.
not_optimization: Exhaust15nonempty subsets of4existing programs under two laws, not search over schedules, routes, frequencies or joint fleet rotations
non_launch_reference: Incremental action0 is a comparison baseline only; actual retained-company profit and obligations remain UNKNOWN
rejection: Inconsistent shared market definitions, lost/duplicate physical IDs, own-cap duplication, calendar conflict inside a dedicated component tail, or singleton mismatch holds results
independent_review: PENDING_NEW_PACKAGE; no expansion of earlier reviews
